<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller=function($timeout) {
  var c = this;

  // ── PAGE IDs (confirmed from your ServiceNow Pages list) ──
  var PAGE_IDS = {
    home:           'test_catalog',
    myAppointments: 'my_appointments',
    labReports:     'lab_reports'
  };

  c.step = 1;
  c.processing = false;
  c.errors = {};
  c.genderOpen = false;
  c.bankOpen = false;
  c.testPrice = '0.00';
  c.validationMsg = '';

  c.form = {
    first_name: '', last_name: '', email: '', phone_number: '',
    date_of_birth: '', gender: '', address: '',
    scheduled_date: '', slot_time: '', notes: ''
  };

  c.payment = {
    method: 'card',
    card_name: '', card_number: '', expiry: '', cvv: '',
    upi_id: '', upi_app: '',
    bank: '',
    insurance_provider: '', policy_number: ''
  };

  c.genderOptions = [
    { value: 'male',              label: 'Male' },
    { value: 'female',            label: 'Female' },
    { value: 'other',             label: 'Other' },
    { value: 'prefer_not_to_say', label: 'Prefer not to say' }
  ];

  c.bankOptions = [
    { value: 'sbi',   label: 'State Bank of India' },
    { value: 'hdfc',  label: 'HDFC Bank' },
    { value: 'icici', label: 'ICICI Bank' },
    { value: 'axis',  label: 'Axis Bank' },
    { value: 'kotak', label: 'Kotak Mahindra Bank' },
    { value: 'pnb',   label: 'Punjab National Bank' },
    { value: 'bob',   label: 'Bank of Baroda' },
    { value: 'other', label: 'Other Bank' }
  ];

  c.timeSlots = [
    '08:00 AM','08:30 AM','09:00 AM','09:30 AM',
    '10:00 AM','10:30 AM','11:00 AM','11:30 AM',
    '12:00 PM','12:30 PM','01:00 PM','01:30 PM',
    '02:00 PM','02:30 PM','03:00 PM','03:30 PM',
    '04:00 PM','04:30 PM','05:00 PM'
  ];

  // FIX: padStart() not always available in ServiceNow's JS engine — use manual pad
  function pad2(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }
  var today = new Date();
  c.minDate = today.getFullYear() + '-' + pad2(today.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(today.getDate());

  // ── NAVIGATION ────────────────────────────────────────────
  var _nav = function(pageId) {
    var portalId = window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] || 'sp';
    window.location.href = '/' + portalId + '?id=' + pageId;
  };

  // ── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.$onInit = function() {
    var sysId    = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_sys_id')   || '';
    var name     = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_name')     || '';
    var price    = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_price')    || '0';
    var code     = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_code')     || '';
    var category = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_category') || 'General';
    var duration = sessionStorage.getItem('selected_test_duration') || '';

    if (sysId) {
      var numPrice = parseFloat(price) || 0;
      c.selectedTest = {
        sys_id: sysId, test_name: name, price: numPrice,
        test_code: code, category: category, test_duration: duration
      };
      c.testPrice = numPrice.toFixed(2);
      ['selected_test_sys_id','selected_test_name','selected_test_price',
       'selected_test_code','selected_test_category','selected_test_duration']
        .forEach(function(k) { sessionStorage.removeItem(k); });
    } else if (c.data && c.data.test) {
      c.selectedTest = c.data.test;
      c.testPrice = (parseFloat(c.data.test.price) || 0).toFixed(2);
    }

    if (c.data && c.data.currentUser) {
      c.form.first_name   = c.data.currentUser.first_name || '';
      c.form.last_name    = c.data.currentUser.last_name  || '';
      c.form.email        = c.data.currentUser.email      || '';
      c.form.phone_number = c.data.currentUser.phone      || '';
    }
  };

  // ── DROPDOWN HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────
  c.getGenderLabel = function(val) {
    for (var i = 0; i < c.genderOptions.length; i++) {
      if (c.genderOptions[i].value === val) return c.genderOptions[i].label;
    }
    return '-- Select Gender --';
  };
  c.getBankLabel = function(val) {
    for (var i = 0; i < c.bankOptions.length; i++) {
      if (c.bankOptions[i].value === val) return c.bankOptions[i].label;
    }
    return '-- Select Bank --';
  };
  c.selectGender = function(val) { c.form.gender = val; c.genderOpen = false; c.clearError('gender'); };
  c.selectBank   = function(val) { c.payment.bank = val; c.bankOpen = false; };
  c.setPaymentMethod = function(method) { c.payment.method = method; c.bankOpen = false; c.genderOpen = false; };
  c.selectUpiApp = function(app) { c.payment.upi_app = app; };

  // ── MISC HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────────
  c.getCategoryIcon = function(cat) {
    var icons = {
      'blood':']]>🩸<![CDATA[','urine':']]>🧪<![CDATA[','imaging':']]>🩻<![CDATA[','radiology':']]>🩻<![CDATA[',
      'cardiology':'❤️','neurology':']]>🧠<![CDATA[','genetics':']]>🧬<![CDATA[','pathology':']]>🔬<![CDATA[',
      'biochemistry':'⚗️','allergy':']]>🌿<![CDATA[','microbiology':']]>🦠<![CDATA[','covid':']]>😷<![CDATA[',
      'ecg':'❤️','x-ray':']]>🩻<![CDATA[','xray':']]>🩻<![CDATA[','diabetes':']]>💉<![CDATA[','thyroid':']]>🦋<![CDATA['
    };
    if (!cat) return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
    var key = cat.toLowerCase();
    for (var k in icons) { if (key.indexOf(k) !== -1) return icons[k]; }
    return ']]>🔬<![CDATA[';
  };

  c.formatDateDisplay = function(dateStr) {
    if (!dateStr) return '';
    // Normalize: handle both string and Date object
    if (typeof dateStr !== 'string') {
      try { dateStr = dateStr.toISOString().split('T')[0]; } catch(e) { return ''; }
    }
    var parts = dateStr.split('-');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return dateStr;
    var yr = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    var mo = parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1;
    var dy = parseInt(parts[2], 10);
    var d = new Date(yr, mo, dy);
    var months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    var days   = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
    return days[d.getDay()] + ', ' + dy + ' ' + months[mo] + ' ' + yr;
  };

  c.getPaymentLabel = function(method) {
    var labels = {
      'card':'Credit/Debit Card','upi':'UPI Payment',
      'netbanking':'Net Banking','insurance':'Insurance','cash':'Pay on Arrival'
    };
    return labels[method] || method;
  };

  c.selectSlot = function(slot) { c.form.slot_time = slot; c.clearError('slot_time'); };

  c.onDateChange = function() { c.form.slot_time = ''; c.clearError('scheduled_date'); };

  c.clearError = function(field) {
    if (c.errors[field]) delete c.errors[field];
    c.validationMsg = '';
  };

  // ── STEP NAVIGATION (direct — ng-click already triggers digest) ───
  var _goToStep = function(n) {
    c.step = n;
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  };

  // ── STEP 1 VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────
  c.validateStep1 = function() {
    c.errors = {};
    c.validationMsg = '';
    var f = c.form;
    var emailReg = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    var phoneReg = /^\+?[\d\s\-(). ]{7,20}$/;

    if (!f.first_name || !f.first_name.trim()) c.errors.first_name   = 'First name is required';
    if (!f.last_name  || !f.last_name.trim())  c.errors.last_name    = 'Last name is required';
    if (!f.email      || !f.email.trim())      c.errors.email        = 'Email is required';
    else if (!emailReg.test(f.email.trim()))   c.errors.email        = 'Enter a valid email';
    if (!f.phone_number || !f.phone_number.trim()) c.errors.phone_number = 'Phone number is required';
    else if (!phoneReg.test(f.phone_number.trim())) c.errors.phone_number = 'Enter a valid phone number';
    if (!f.date_of_birth) c.errors.date_of_birth = 'Date of birth is required';
    if (!f.gender)        c.errors.gender        = 'Please select a gender';

    if (Object.keys(c.errors).length > 0) {
      c.validationMsg = 'Please fill in all required fields marked below.';
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      return;
    }
    _goToStep(2);
  };

  // ── STEP 2 VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────────────
  // KEY FIX: Robust date handling — works with string, Date object, or missing value
  c.validateStep2 = function() {
    c.errors = {};
    c.validationMsg = '';

    // Normalize the date value safely
    var rawDate = c.form.scheduled_date;
    var dateStr = '';

    if (rawDate) {
      if (typeof rawDate === 'string') {
        dateStr = rawDate.trim();
      } else if (rawDate instanceof Date) {
        // ng-model on type="date" can return a Date object in some AngularJS builds
        var yr = rawDate.getFullYear();
        var mo = rawDate.getMonth() + 1;
        var dy = rawDate.getDate();
        dateStr = yr + '-' + pad2(mo) + '-' + pad2(dy);
        c.form.scheduled_date = dateStr; // Normalize to string
      } else {
        dateStr = String(rawDate).trim();
      }
    }

    if (!dateStr) {
      c.errors.scheduled_date = 'Please select a date';
    } else {
      try {
        var parts = dateStr.split('-');
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          var sel = new Date(parseInt(parts[0], 10), parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1, parseInt(parts[2], 10));
          var now = new Date();
          now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
          if (sel < now) c.errors.scheduled_date = 'Please select a future date';
        }
      } catch (ex) {
        c.errors.scheduled_date = 'Invalid date selected';
      }
    }

    if (!c.form.slot_time) {
      c.errors.slot_time = 'Please select a time slot';
    }

    if (Object.keys(c.errors).length > 0) {
      c.validationMsg = 'Please select a date and time slot before continuing.';
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      return;
    }

    _goToStep(3);
  };

  // ── PAYMENT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  c.processPayment = function() {
    c.processing = true;
    $timeout(function() { c.submitBooking(); }, 1200);
  };

  c.submitBooking = function() {
    c.server.get({
      action: 'create_appointment',
      data: {
        form: c.form,
        test_sys_id: c.selectedTest ? c.selectedTest.sys_id : '',
        payment_method: c.payment.method,
        total_amount: c.selectedTest ? c.selectedTest.price : 0
      }
    }).then(function(r) {
      c.processing = false;
      if (r.data.success) {
        c.data.appointmentNumber = r.data.appointment_number;
        _goToStep(4);
      } else {
        alert('Error: ' + (r.data.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'));
      }
    }).catch(function() {
      c.processing = false;
      alert('Network error. Please try again.');
    });
  };

  c.prevStep = function() {
    if (c.step > 1) _goToStep(c.step - 1);
  };

  c.changeTest         = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.home); };
  c.viewMyAppointments = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.myAppointments); };
  c.bookAnother        = function() { _nav(PAGE_IDS.home); };
}]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.appt-booking {
  --blue:#0a2463; --blue2:#1e3a8a; --cyan:#00b4d8; --cyan2:#0096c7;
  --green:#10b981; --amber:#f59e0b; --red:#ef4444;
  --g50:#f8fafc; --g100:#f1f5f9; --g200:#e2e8f0;
  --g400:#94a3b8; --g600:#475569; --g800:#1e293b; --wht:#ffffff;
  --r:14px; --sh:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.07);
  font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;
  max-width:800px; margin:0 auto;
  padding:28px 20px 60px; background:var(--g50); min-height:100vh;
}

/* ── PROGRESS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.progress-wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:32px; gap:0; }
.progress-step { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.step-circle {
  width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%; border:3px solid var(--g200);
  background:var(--g200); color:var(--g400);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:700; transition:all .3s;
}
.progress-step.active .step-circle { background:var(--blue); border-color:var(--blue); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(10,36,99,.25); }
.progress-step.done   .step-circle { background:var(--green); border-color:var(--green); color:#fff; }
.step-label { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; color:var(--g400); white-space:nowrap; }
.progress-step.active .step-label,
.progress-step.done   .step-label { color:var(--blue); }
.step-line { flex:1; min-width:40px; max-width:90px; height:3px; background:var(--g200); margin-top:-22px; transition:background .3s; }
.step-line.filled { background:var(--green); }

/* ── TEST BANNER ───────────────────────────────────── */
.test-banner {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#eff6ff,#dbeafe);
  border:1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius:var(--r);
  padding:14px 18px; margin-bottom:24px;
}
.test-banner-icon { font-size:34px; flex-shrink:0; }
.test-banner-info { flex:1; }
.test-banner-name { display:block; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--blue); }
.test-banner-meta { display:block; font-size:12px; color:var(--g600); margin-top:2px; }
.test-banner-price { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px; }
.price-tag { font-size:26px; font-weight:800; color:var(--blue); }
.btn-change-test {
  background:none; border:1px solid var(--cyan); color:var(--cyan2);
  padding:4px 12px; border-radius:20px; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-change-test:hover { background:var(--cyan); color:#fff; }
.no-test-warn {
  background:#fef3c7; border:1px solid #fcd34d; border-radius:10px;
  padding:12px 16px; color:#92400e; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:20px;
}
.no-test-warn a { color:var(--cyan2); cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline; }

/* ── STEP HEADER ───────────────────────────────────── */
.step-header { margin-bottom:20px; }
.step-header h2 { font-size:21px; font-weight:800; color:var(--g800); margin:0 0 4px; }
.step-header p  { color:var(--g600); font-size:13px; margin:0; }

/* ── FORM CARD ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.form-card {
  background:var(--wht); border-radius:var(--r); border:1px solid var(--g200);
  padding:24px; box-shadow:var(--sh); margin-bottom:20px;
}
.form-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; }
.form-group { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; }
.form-full { grid-column:1 / -1; }
.form-label { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--g800); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.4px; }
.form-label.req::after { content:' *'; color:var(--red); }

/* ── INPUTS ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.form-input {
  padding:11px 14px; border:2px solid var(--g200); border-radius:10px;
  font-size:14px; color:var(--g800); background:var(--wht);
  outline:none; transition:border .2s; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box;
  font-family:inherit;
}
.form-input:focus { border-color:var(--cyan); }
.has-error .form-input { border-color:var(--red); }
textarea.form-input { resize:vertical; min-height:72px; }
.err-msg { font-size:12px; color:var(--red); font-weight:500; }

/* ── CUSTOM SELECT (fixes broken <select> in Service Portal) ── */
.cust-select { position:relative; }
.cust-sel-trigger {
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:11px 14px; border:2px solid var(--g200); border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--wht); cursor:pointer; transition:border .2s;
  font-size:14px; color:var(--g800); user-select:none;
}
.cust-sel-trigger:hover,
.cust-select.open .cust-sel-trigger { border-color:var(--cyan); }
.cust-sel-val { flex:1; }
.cust-sel-menu {
  position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 4px); left:0; right:0; z-index:999;
  background:var(--wht); border:2px solid var(--cyan); border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12); overflow:hidden;
}
.cust-sel-item {
  padding:11px 16px; font-size:14px; color:var(--g800);
  cursor:pointer; transition:background .12s; border-bottom:1px solid var(--g100);
}
.cust-sel-item:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.cust-sel-item:hover  { background:#f0f9ff; }
.cust-sel-item.selected { background:#dbeafe; color:var(--blue); font-weight:600; }
.has-error .cust-sel-trigger { border-color:var(--red); }

/* ── TIME SLOTS ────────────────────────────────────── */
.slots-section { margin-top:16px; }
.slots-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(88px,1fr)); gap:7px; margin-top:8px; }
.slot-btn {
  padding:8px 4px; border:2px solid var(--g200); border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--wht); color:var(--g800); font-size:12px; font-weight:600;
  cursor:pointer; transition:all .15s; text-align:center;
}
.slot-btn:hover   { border-color:var(--cyan); color:var(--cyan2); background:#f0f9ff; }
.slot-btn.selected { background:var(--blue); border-color:var(--blue); color:#fff; }

/* ── BOOKING SUMMARY ───────────────────────────────── */
.booking-summary {
  background:#f0fdf4; border:1px solid #bbf7d0; border-radius:var(--r);
  padding:16px 20px; margin-bottom:20px;
}
.booking-summary h4 { font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:#166534; margin:0 0 10px; }
.sum-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:13px; padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #dcfce7; }
.sum-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.sum-row span   { color:var(--g600); }
.sum-row strong { color:var(--g800); }

/* ── ORDER CARD ────────────────────────────────────── */
.order-card { background:var(--wht); border-radius:var(--r); border:1px solid var(--g200); overflow:hidden; margin-bottom:20px; }
.order-hdr  { background:var(--blue); color:#fff; padding:13px 18px; font-weight:700; font-size:14px; }
.order-row  { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:11px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--g100); font-size:13px; color:var(--g800); }
.order-divider { border-top:2px solid var(--g200); }
.order-total { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:14px 18px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:var(--g800); }
.order-total-price { font-size:22px; color:var(--blue); }

/* ── PAYMENT METHODS ───────────────────────────────── */
.pay-methods { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); gap:10px; margin-bottom:20px; }
.pay-method {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  padding:14px 8px; border:2px solid var(--g200); border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--wht); cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s;
  position:relative; text-align:center;
}
.pay-method:hover    { border-color:var(--cyan); }
.pay-method.active   { border-color:var(--blue); background:#eff6ff; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(10,36,99,.1); }
.pay-icon  { font-size:24px; }
.pay-lbl   { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--g800); line-height:1.2; }
.pay-tick  {
  position:absolute; top:5px; right:7px; width:17px; height:17px;
  background:var(--green); color:#fff; border-radius:50%;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:10px; font-weight:700;
}

/* ── SECURE TAG ────────────────────────────────────── */
.secure-tag {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
  background:#ecfdf5; border:1px solid #a7f3d0; border-radius:8px;
  padding:9px 14px; color:#065f46; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:18px;
}

/* ── UPI APPS ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.upi-apps { display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.upi-app-tile {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  padding:12px 14px; border:2px solid var(--g200); border-radius:12px;
  background:var(--wht); cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s;
  min-width:64px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--g800);
}
.upi-app-tile:hover  { border-color:var(--cyan); }
.upi-app-tile.upi-active { border-color:var(--blue); background:#eff6ff; color:var(--blue); }
.upi-app-logo {
  width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:16px; font-weight:900; color:#fff;
}

/* ── CASH ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cash-card { text-align:center; padding:28px !important; }
.cash-emoji { font-size:44px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.cash-card h4 { font-size:17px; color:var(--g800); margin:0 0 8px; }
.cash-card p  { color:var(--g600); font-size:14px; margin:0 0 6px; }
.cash-note    { color:var(--g400); font-size:12px; font-style:italic; }

/* ── STEP ACTIONS ──────────────────────────────────── */
.step-actions { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:4px; }
.btn-back, .btn-next, .btn-pay {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px;
  padding:12px 24px; border-radius:10px; font-size:14px; font-weight:700;
  cursor:pointer; border:none; transition:all .2s;
}
.btn-back { background:var(--wht); color:var(--g600); border:2px solid var(--g200); }
.btn-back:hover { border-color:var(--g400); }
.btn-next { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--blue2)); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(10,36,99,.28); }
.btn-next:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(10,36,99,.34); }
.btn-pay  { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green),#059669); color:#fff; box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(16,185,129,.3); padding:13px 28px; font-size:15px; }
.btn-pay:hover    { transform:translateY(-1px); }
.btn-pay:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:not-allowed; transform:none; }

/* ── SUCCESS ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.success-wrap   { text-align:center; padding-top:16px; }
.success-circle {
  width:88px; height:88px; background:var(--green); border-radius:50%;
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:38px; color:#fff; margin-bottom:20px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(16,185,129,.38);
  animation:pop .5s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97);
}
@keyframes pop { 0%{transform:scale(0)} 80%{transform:scale(1.1)} 100%{transform:scale(1)} }
.success-title { font-size:26px; font-weight:800; color:var(--g800); margin:0 0 10px; }
.success-sub   { color:var(--g600); font-size:14px; margin:0 0 24px; }
.conf-card {
  background:var(--wht); border-radius:var(--r); border:1px solid var(--g200);
  padding:20px; text-align:left; max-width:480px; margin:0 auto 24px;
}
.conf-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--g100); font-size:13px; }
.conf-row:last-child { border-bottom:none; }
.conf-row span  { color:var(--g600); }
.conf-row strong { color:var(--g800); }
.appt-code  { color:var(--blue); font-family:'Courier New',monospace; }
.paid-green { color:var(--green); }
.status-warn { color:var(--amber); }
.next-steps-wrap { max-width:480px; margin:0 auto 24px; text-align:left; }
.next-steps-wrap h4 { font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--g800); margin:0 0 12px; }
.next-step-row { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; background:var(--g50); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--g100); margin-bottom:8px; }
.ns-ico { font-size:20px; flex-shrink:0; }
.next-step-row strong { font-size:13px; color:var(--g800); display:block; margin-bottom:2px; }
.next-step-row span   { font-size:12px; color:var(--g600); }
.success-btns { display:flex; gap:12px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }

/* ── RESPONSIVE ────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width:600px) {
  .form-grid   { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .pay-methods { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
  .step-line   { min-width:16px; }
  .appt-booking { padding:16px 12px 40px; }
}

/* VALIDATION TOAST */
.val-toast {
  background: #fef2f2;
  border: 2px solid #fca5a5;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  color: #b91c1c;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  animation: shake 0.4s ease;
}
@keyframes shake {
  0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}
  20%,60%{transform:translateX(-5px)}
  40%,80%{transform:translateX(5px)}
}</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Widget to display and manage functionalities</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>false</has_preview><id>appointment_booking</id><internal>false</internal><link><![CDATA[function link(scope, element, attrs, controller) {
  
}]]></link><name>Appointment Booking</name><option_schema/><public>true</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

  data.test        = null;
  data.currentUser = null;
  data.success     = false;
  data.error       = '';
  data.appointmentNumber = '';

  // ── Safe user detection (no isAnonymous — not allowed in scope) ──
  try {
    var userID   = gs.getUserID()   || '';
    var userName = gs.getUserName() || '';

    if (userID && userName !== 'guest' && userName !== '') {
      var userGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
      if (userGr.get(userID)) {
        data.currentUser = {
          first_name: userGr.getValue('first_name')    || '',
          last_name:  userGr.getValue('last_name')     || '',
          email:      userGr.getValue('email')         || '',
          phone:      userGr.getValue('mobile_phone')  || userGr.getValue('phone') || ''
        };
      }
    }
  } catch(e) {
    gs.error('Booking init error: ' + e.message);
  }

  // ── Handle appointment creation ──────────────────────────
  if (input && input.action === 'create_appointment') {
    try {
      var formData      = input.data.form        || {};
      var testSysId     = input.data.test_sys_id || '';
      var totalAmount   = parseFloat(input.data.total_amount) || 0;
      var paymentMethod = input.data.payment_method || 'card';

      // Fetch test name & code for email
      var testName = '', testCode = '';
      if (testSysId) {
        var testGr = new GlideRecord('x_2056539_medica_0_diagnostic_test');
        if (testGr.get(testSysId)) {
          testName = testGr.getValue('test_name') || '';
          testCode = testGr.getValue('test_code') || '';
        }
      }

      // ── Find or create PATIENT record (not sys_user!) ────
      var patientSysId = '';
      var patGr = new GlideRecord('x_2056539_medica_0_patient');
      patGr.addQuery('email', formData.email || '');
      patGr.setLimit(1);
      patGr.query();

      if (patGr.next()) {
        // Update existing patient
        patientSysId = patGr.getUniqueValue();
        patGr.setValue('first_name',   formData.first_name   || '');
        patGr.setValue('last_name',    formData.last_name    || '');
        patGr.setValue('phone_number', formData.phone_number || '');
        patGr.setValue('address',      formData.address      || '');
        patGr.update();
      } else {
        // Create new patient record
        var newPat = new GlideRecord('x_2056539_medica_0_patient');
        newPat.initialize();
        newPat.setValue('first_name',    formData.first_name    || '');
        newPat.setValue('last_name',     formData.last_name     || '');
        newPat.setValue('email',         formData.email         || '');
        newPat.setValue('phone_number',  formData.phone_number  || '');
        newPat.setValue('date_of_birth', formData.date_of_birth || '');
        newPat.setValue('gender',        formData.gender        || '');
        newPat.setValue('address',       formData.address       || '');

        // Link to sys_user if logged in
        var uid = gs.getUserID();
        if (uid && gs.getUserName() !== 'guest') {
          newPat.setValue('user', uid);
        }
        patientSysId = newPat.insert();
      }

      if (!patientSysId) {
        data.error = 'Failed to create patient record. Check table ACLs.';
        return;
      }

      // ── Create appointment ────────────────────────────────
      var apptNum = 'APPT-' + new Date().getFullYear() + '-' +
                    (Math.floor(Math.random() * 90000) + 10000);

      var apptGr = new GlideRecord('x_2056539_medica_0_appointment_table');
      apptGr.initialize();
      apptGr.setValue('appointment_number', apptNum);
      apptGr.setValue('patient',            patientSysId);  // links to patient table
      apptGr.setValue('test',               testSysId);     // links to diagnostic test
      apptGr.setValue('status',             'pending');
      apptGr.setValue('approval_status',    'requested');
      apptGr.setValue('payment_status',     'paid');
      apptGr.setValue('total_amount',       totalAmount);
      apptGr.setValue('scheduled_date',     formData.scheduled_date || '');
      apptGr.setValue('slot_time',          formData.slot_time      || '');
      apptGr.setValue('notes',              formData.notes          || '');
      apptGr.setValue('confirmation_sent',  false);
      apptGr.setValue('email',              formData.email || '');  // ← NEW: Save email to appointment table

      var uid2 = gs.getUserID();
      if (uid2 && gs.getUserName() !== 'guest') {
        apptGr.setValue('created_by', uid2);
      }

      var apptSysId = apptGr.insert();
      if (!apptSysId) {
        data.error = 'Failed to create appointment. Check table permissions.';
        return;
      }

      // ── Patient confirmation email ────────────────────────
      try {
        var patEmail = new GlideEmailOutbound();
        patEmail.setTo(formData.email);
        patEmail.setSubject('Appointment Confirmed: ' + apptNum + ' — MediCare Diagnostic Center');
        patEmail.setBody(
          '<div style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;">' +
          '<div style="background:#0a2463;padding:24px;text-align:center;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;">' +
          '<h2 style="color:#fff;margin:0;">]]>🏥<![CDATA[ MediCare Diagnostic Center</h2></div>' +
          '<div style="background:#f0fdf4;border:2px solid #10b981;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;padding:24px;">' +
          '<h3 style="color:#065f46;">✅ Booking Confirmed!</h3>' +
          '<p>Dear ' + (formData.first_name||'') + ' ' + (formData.last_name||'') + ',</p>' +
          '<table style="width:100%;font-size:14px;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;">' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Appointment #</td><td style="padding:10px;">' + apptNum + '</td></tr>' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Test</td><td style="padding:10px;">' + testName + ' (' + testCode + ')</td></tr>' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Date</td><td style="padding:10px;">' + (formData.scheduled_date||'') + '</td></tr>' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Time</td><td style="padding:10px;">' + (formData.slot_time||'') + '</td></tr>' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Amount Paid</td><td style="padding:10px;color:#10b981;font-weight:700;">$' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>' +
          '<tr><td style="padding:10px;background:#f8fafc;font-weight:600;">Payment</td><td style="padding:10px;">' + paymentMethod + '</td></tr>' +
          '</table>' +
          '<p style="margin-top:16px;color:#6b7280;font-size:13px;">Pending admin approval. You will receive a confirmation within 24 hours.</p>' +
          '</div></div>'
        );
        patEmail.save();
      } catch(emailErr) { gs.warn('Patient email error: ' + emailErr.message); }

      // ── Admin approval email ──────────────────────────────
      try {
        var adminEmail = gs.getProperty('medicare.admin.email', '');
        if (adminEmail) {
          var adminMail = new GlideEmailOutbound();
          adminMail.setTo(adminEmail);
          adminMail.setSubject('[Action Required] New Appointment: ' + apptNum);
          adminMail.setBody(
            '<div style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif;max-width:600px;">' +
            '<div style="background:#0a2463;padding:20px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;"><h2 style="color:#fff;margin:0;">New Appointment — Approval Required</h2></div>' +
            '<div style="background:#fffbeb;border:2px solid #f59e0b;border-radius:0 0 8px 8px;padding:24px;">' +
            '<table style="width:100%;font-size:14px;border-collapse:collapse;">' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;width:40%;">Appointment #</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + apptNum + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Patient</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + (formData.first_name||'') + ' ' + (formData.last_name||'') + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Email</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + (formData.email||'') + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Phone</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + (formData.phone_number||'') + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Test</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + testName + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Date & Time</td><td style="padding:8px;">' + (formData.scheduled_date||'') + ' ' + (formData.slot_time||'') + '</td></tr>' +
            '<tr><td style="padding:8px;font-weight:600;">Amount</td><td style="padding:8px;color:#059669;font-weight:700;">$' + totalAmount.toFixed(2) + '</td></tr>' +
            '</table>' +
            '<div style="margin-top:20px;padding:12px;background:#f1f5f9;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;color:#475569;">To approve or reject: open the appointment record in ServiceNow backend and change the <strong>Approval Status</strong> field.</div>' +
            '</div></div>'
          );
          adminMail.save();
        }
      } catch(admErr) { gs.warn('Admin email error: ' + admErr.message); }

      // Mark confirmation sent
      var cfGr = new GlideRecord('x_2056539_medica_0_appointment_table');
      if (cfGr.get(apptSysId)) {
        cfGr.setValue('confirmation_sent', true);
        cfGr.update();
      }

      data.success            = true;
      data.appointment_number = apptNum;
      data.appointment_sys_id = apptSysId;

    } catch(submitErr) {
      gs.error('Create Appointment Error: ' + submitErr.message);
      data.error = submitErr.message;
    }
  }

})();]]></script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 10:04:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>0c00497a834b0350428191d6feaad3f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Appointment Booking</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center" source="x_2056539_medica_0">3c5d102a83c38f10428191d6feaad3ca</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Medical Diagnosis Center">3c5d102a83c38f10428191d6feaad3ca</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_0c00497a834b0350428191d6feaad3f5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 10:24:11</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class="appt-booking">
  <!-- PROGRESS STEPS -->
  <div class="progress-wrap">
    <div class="progress-step" ng-class="{'active': c.step >= 1, 'done': c.step > 1}">
      <div class="step-circle"><i class="fa fa-check" ng-if="c.step > 1"></i><span ng-if="c.step <= 1">1</span></div>
      <span class="step-label">Details</span>
    </div>
    <div class="step-line" ng-class="{'filled': c.step > 1}"></div>
    <div class="progress-step" ng-class="{'active': c.step >= 2, 'done': c.step > 2}">
      <div class="step-circle"><i class="fa fa-check" ng-if="c.step > 2"></i><span ng-if="c.step <= 2">2</span></div>
      <span class="step-label">Schedule</span>
    </div>
    <div class="step-line" ng-class="{'filled': c.step > 2}"></div>
    <div class="progress-step" ng-class="{'active': c.step >= 3, 'done': c.step > 3}">
      <div class="step-circle"><i class="fa fa-check" ng-if="c.step > 3"></i><span ng-if="c.step <= 3">3</span></div>
      <span class="step-label">Payment</span>
    </div>
    <div class="step-line" ng-class="{'filled': c.step > 3}"></div>
    <div class="progress-step" ng-class="{'active': c.step >= 4}">
      <div class="step-circle"><span>4</span></div>
      <span class="step-label">Done</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TEST BANNER — ng-bind used instead of {{}} for price -->
  <div class="test-banner" ng-if="c.selectedTest">
    <div class="test-banner-icon" ng-bind="c.getCategoryIcon(c.selectedTest.category)"></div>
    <div class="test-banner-info">
      <span class="test-banner-name" ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_name"></span>
      <span class="test-banner-meta">
        <span ng-bind="c.selectedTest.category"></span> ·
        Code: <span ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_code"></span> ·
        Duration: <span ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_duration"></span>
      </span>
    </div>
    <div class="test-banner-price">
      <span class="price-tag">$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span></span>
      <button class="btn-change-test" ng-click="c.changeTest()">Change Test</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="no-test-warn" ng-if="!c.selectedTest">
    <i class="fa fa-exclamation-triangle"></i>
    No test selected. <a ng-click="c.changeTest()">Back to catalog</a>
  </div>

  <!-- ===== STEP 1: PATIENT DETAILS ===== -->
  <div class="booking-step" ng-show="c.step === 1">
    <div class="step-header">
      <h2>👤 Patient Information</h2>
      <p>Fill in your personal details to proceed.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="form-card">
      <div class="form-grid">

        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.first_name}">
          <label class="form-label req">First Name</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="First name"
            ng-model="c.form.first_name" ng-change="c.clearError('first_name')" />
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.first_name" ng-bind="c.errors.first_name"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.last_name}">
          <label class="form-label req">Last Name</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Last name"
            ng-model="c.form.last_name" ng-change="c.clearError('last_name')" />
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.last_name" ng-bind="c.errors.last_name"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.email}">
          <label class="form-label req">Email Address</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com"
            ng-model="c.form.email" ng-change="c.clearError('email')" />
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.email" ng-bind="c.errors.email"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.phone_number}">
          <label class="form-label req">Phone Number</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="tel" placeholder="+1 555 000 0000"
            ng-model="c.form.phone_number" ng-change="c.clearError('phone_number')" />
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.phone_number" ng-bind="c.errors.phone_number"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.date_of_birth}">
          <label class="form-label req">Date of Birth</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="date"
            ng-model="c.form.date_of_birth" ng-change="c.clearError('date_of_birth')" />
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.date_of_birth" ng-bind="c.errors.date_of_birth"></span>
        </div>

        <!-- GENDER custom dropdown -->
        <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.gender}">
          <label class="form-label req">Gender</label>
          <div class="cust-select" ng-class="{'open': c.genderOpen}">
            <div class="cust-sel-trigger" ng-click="c.genderOpen = !c.genderOpen; c.bankOpen = false;">
              <span class="cust-sel-val" ng-if="!c.form.gender" style="color:#94a3b8;">-- Select Gender --</span>
              <span class="cust-sel-val" ng-if="c.form.gender" ng-bind="c.getGenderLabel(c.form.gender)"></span>
              <i class="fa" ng-class="c.genderOpen ? 'fa-chevron-up' : 'fa-chevron-down'" style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:12px;"></i>
            </div>
            <div class="cust-sel-menu" ng-if="c.genderOpen">
              <div class="cust-sel-item" ng-repeat="opt in c.genderOptions"
                ng-click="c.selectGender(opt.value)"
                ng-class="{'selected': c.form.gender === opt.value}"
                ng-bind="opt.label">
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.gender" ng-bind="c.errors.gender"></span>
        </div>

        <div class="form-group form-full">
          <label class="form-label">Address</label>
          <textarea class="form-input" rows="2" placeholder="Your full address"
            ng-model="c.form.address"></textarea>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="step-actions">
      <button class="btn-back" ng-click="c.changeTest()"><i class="fa fa-arrow-left"></i> Back to Catalog</button>
      <button class="btn-next" ng-click="c.validateStep1()">Continue <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Validation message -->
<div ng-if="c.validationMsg" style="background:#fef2f2;border:2px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#b91c1c;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
  <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
  <span>{{c.validationMsg}}</span>
</div>

  <!-- ===== STEP 2: SCHEDULE ===== -->
  <div class="booking-step" ng-show="c.step === 2">
    <div class="step-header">
      <h2>📅 Schedule Appointment</h2>
      <p>Choose your preferred date and time slot.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="form-card">
      <div class="form-group" ng-class="{'has-error': c.errors.scheduled_date}">
        <label class="form-label req">Preferred Date</label>
        <input class="form-input" type="date" ng-model="c.form.scheduled_date"
          ng-attr-min="{{c.minDate}}" ng-change="c.onDateChange()" />
        <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.scheduled_date" ng-bind="c.errors.scheduled_date"></span>
      </div>

      <div class="slots-section" ng-if="c.form.scheduled_date">
        <label class="form-label req" style="display:block;margin-bottom:10px;">Available Time Slots</label>
        <div class="slots-grid">
          <button class="slot-btn" ng-repeat="slot in c.timeSlots"
            ng-class="{'selected': c.form.slot_time === slot}"
            ng-click="c.selectSlot(slot)"
            ng-bind="slot">
          </button>
        </div>
        <span class="err-msg" ng-if="c.errors.slot_time" ng-bind="c.errors.slot_time"></span>
      </div>

      <div class="form-group" style="margin-top:20px;">
        <label class="form-label">Notes (optional)</label>
        <textarea class="form-input" rows="3" placeholder="Any special instructions..."
          ng-model="c.form.notes"></textarea>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Booking Summary — FIX: use ng-bind for all dynamic values -->
    <div class="booking-summary">
      <h4>📋 Booking Summary</h4>
      <div class="sum-row">
        <span>Test</span>
        <strong ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_name"></strong>
      </div>
      <div class="sum-row">
        <span>Patient</span>
        <strong><span ng-bind="c.form.first_name"></span> <span ng-bind="c.form.last_name"></span></strong>
      </div>
      <div class="sum-row" ng-if="c.form.scheduled_date">
        <span>Date</span>
        <strong ng-bind="c.formatDateDisplay(c.form.scheduled_date)"></strong>
      </div>
      <div class="sum-row" ng-if="c.form.slot_time">
        <span>Time</span>
        <strong ng-bind="c.form.slot_time"></strong>
      </div>
      <div class="sum-row">
        <span>Amount</span>
        <strong style="color:#0a2463;">$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span></strong>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="step-actions">
      <button class="btn-back" ng-click="c.prevStep()"><i class="fa fa-arrow-left"></i> Back</button>
      <button class="btn-next" ng-click="c.validateStep2()">Continue to Payment <i class="fa fa-arrow-right"></i></button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Validation message -->
<div ng-if="c.validationMsg" style="background:#fef2f2;border:2px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;color:#b91c1c;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;">
  <i class="fa fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
  <span>{{c.validationMsg}}</span>
</div>

  <!-- ===== STEP 3: PAYMENT ===== -->
  <div class="booking-step" ng-show="c.step === 3">
    <div class="step-header">
      <h2>💳 Payment</h2>
      <p>Select a payment method and confirm your booking.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- Order Summary — all using ng-bind -->
    <div class="order-card">
      <div class="order-hdr">Order Summary</div>
      <div class="order-row">
        <span ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_name"></span>
        <span>$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="order-row">
        <span>Date & Time</span>
        <span><span ng-bind="c.formatDateDisplay(c.form.scheduled_date)"></span> · <span ng-bind="c.form.slot_time"></span></span>
      </div>
      <div class="order-row"><span>Service Fee</span><span>$0.00</span></div>
      <div class="order-divider"></div>
      <div class="order-total">
        <span>Total</span>
        <span class="order-total-price">$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span></span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Payment methods -->
    <label class="form-label" style="display:block;margin-bottom:12px;">Select Payment Method</label>
    <div class="pay-methods">
      <div class="pay-method" ng-class="{'active': c.payment.method === 'card'}" ng-click="c.setPaymentMethod('card')">
        <span class="pay-icon">💳</span><span class="pay-lbl">Card</span>
        <span class="pay-tick" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'card'">✓</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pay-method" ng-class="{'active': c.payment.method === 'upi'}" ng-click="c.setPaymentMethod('upi')">
        <span class="pay-icon">📱</span><span class="pay-lbl">UPI</span>
        <span class="pay-tick" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'upi'">✓</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pay-method" ng-class="{'active': c.payment.method === 'netbanking'}" ng-click="c.setPaymentMethod('netbanking')">
        <span class="pay-icon">🏦</span><span class="pay-lbl">Net Banking</span>
        <span class="pay-tick" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'netbanking'">✓</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pay-method" ng-class="{'active': c.payment.method === 'insurance'}" ng-click="c.setPaymentMethod('insurance')">
        <span class="pay-icon">🏥</span><span class="pay-lbl">Insurance</span>
        <span class="pay-tick" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'insurance'">✓</span>
      </div>
      <div class="pay-method" ng-class="{'active': c.payment.method === 'cash'}" ng-click="c.setPaymentMethod('cash')">
        <span class="pay-icon">💵</span><span class="pay-lbl">Pay on Arrival</span>
        <span class="pay-tick" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'cash'">✓</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Card -->
    <div class="form-card" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'card'">
      <div class="secure-tag"><i class="fa fa-lock"></i> Secure Demo Payment</div>
      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="form-group form-full">
          <label class="form-label">Cardholder Name</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Name on card" ng-model="c.payment.card_name" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-group form-full">
          <label class="form-label">Card Number</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="4242 4242 4242 4242" maxlength="19" ng-model="c.payment.card_number" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Expiry</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="MM/YY" maxlength="5" ng-model="c.payment.expiry" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">CVV</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="password" placeholder="***" maxlength="4" ng-model="c.payment.cvv" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- UPI -->
    <div class="form-card" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'upi'">
      <div class="secure-tag"><i class="fa fa-lock"></i> UPI Demo Payment</div>
      <div class="form-group" style="margin-bottom:16px;">
        <label class="form-label">UPI ID</label>
        <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="yourname@upi" ng-model="c.payment.upi_id" />
      </div>
      <label class="form-label" style="display:block;margin-bottom:10px;">Or choose app</label>
      <div class="upi-apps">
        <div class="upi-app-tile" ng-class="{'upi-active': c.payment.upi_app === 'gpay'}" ng-click="c.selectUpiApp('gpay')">
          <div class="upi-app-logo" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4285f4,#34a853);">G</div>
          <span>GPay</span>
        </div>
        <div class="upi-app-tile" ng-class="{'upi-active': c.payment.upi_app === 'phonepe'}" ng-click="c.selectUpiApp('phonepe')">
          <div class="upi-app-logo" style="background:#5f259f;">P</div>
          <span>PhonePe</span>
        </div>
        <div class="upi-app-tile" ng-class="{'upi-active': c.payment.upi_app === 'paytm'}" ng-click="c.selectUpiApp('paytm')">
          <div class="upi-app-logo" style="background:#00b9f5;color:#002970;">P</div>
          <span>Paytm</span>
        </div>
        <div class="upi-app-tile" ng-class="{'upi-active': c.payment.upi_app === 'bhim'}" ng-click="c.selectUpiApp('bhim')">
          <div class="upi-app-logo" style="background:#ff6600;">B</div>
          <span>BHIM</span>
        </div>
        <div class="upi-app-tile" ng-class="{'upi-active': c.payment.upi_app === 'amazonpay'}" ng-click="c.selectUpiApp('amazonpay')">
          <div class="upi-app-logo" style="background:#ff9900;color:#232f3e;">A</div>
          <span>Amazon</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Net Banking -->
    <div class="form-card" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'netbanking'">
      <div class="secure-tag"><i class="fa fa-lock"></i> Net Banking Demo</div>
      <div class="form-group">
        <label class="form-label">Select Your Bank</label>
        <div class="cust-select" ng-class="{'open': c.bankOpen}">
          <div class="cust-sel-trigger" ng-click="c.bankOpen = !c.bankOpen; c.genderOpen = false;">
            <span class="cust-sel-val" ng-if="!c.payment.bank" style="color:#94a3b8;">-- Select Bank --</span>
            <span class="cust-sel-val" ng-if="c.payment.bank" ng-bind="c.getBankLabel(c.payment.bank)"></span>
            <i class="fa" ng-class="c.bankOpen ? 'fa-chevron-up' : 'fa-chevron-down'" style="color:#94a3b8;font-size:12px;"></i>
          </div>
          <div class="cust-sel-menu" ng-if="c.bankOpen">
            <div class="cust-sel-item" ng-repeat="b in c.bankOptions"
              ng-click="c.selectBank(b.value)"
              ng-class="{'selected': c.payment.bank === b.value}"
              ng-bind="b.label">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Insurance -->
    <div class="form-card" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'insurance'">
      <div class="secure-tag">🏥 Insurance Payment</div>
      <div class="form-grid">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Provider</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="e.g. BlueCross, Aetna" ng-model="c.payment.insurance_provider" />
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label class="form-label">Policy Number</label>
          <input class="form-input" type="text" placeholder="Policy / Member ID" ng-model="c.payment.policy_number" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Cash -->
    <div class="form-card cash-card" ng-if="c.payment.method === 'cash'">
      <div class="cash-emoji">💵</div>
      <h4>Pay on Arrival</h4>
      <p>Pay <strong>$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span></strong> at the center when you arrive.</p>
      <p class="cash-note">Carry a valid ID. Please arrive 15 minutes early.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="step-actions">
      <button class="btn-back" ng-click="c.prevStep()"><i class="fa fa-arrow-left"></i> Back</button>
      <button class="btn-pay" ng-click="c.processPayment()" ng-disabled="c.processing">
        <span ng-if="!c.processing">
          <i class="fa fa-lock"></i> Confirm & Pay $<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span>
        </span>
        <span ng-if="c.processing"><i class="fa fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Processing...</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ===== STEP 4: SUCCESS ===== -->
  <div class="booking-step success-wrap" ng-show="c.step === 4">
    <div class="success-circle"><i class="fa fa-check"></i></div>
    <h2 class="success-title">Appointment Confirmed! 🎉</h2>
    <p class="success-sub">Pending admin approval. Confirmation sent to <strong ng-bind="c.form.email"></strong></p>

    <div class="conf-card">
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Appointment #</span><strong class="appt-code" ng-bind="c.data.appointmentNumber"></strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Patient</span><strong><span ng-bind="c.form.first_name"></span> <span ng-bind="c.form.last_name"></span></strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Test</span><strong ng-bind="c.selectedTest.test_name"></strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Date & Time</span><strong><span ng-bind="c.formatDateDisplay(c.form.scheduled_date)"></span> · <span ng-bind="c.form.slot_time"></span></strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Amount Paid</span><strong class="paid-green">$<span ng-bind="c.testPrice"></span> ✓</strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Payment Via</span><strong ng-bind="c.getPaymentLabel(c.payment.method)"></strong></div>
      <div class="conf-row"><span>Status</span><strong class="status-warn">⏳ Pending Approval</strong></div>
    </div>

    <div class="next-steps-wrap">
      <h4>What happens next?</h4>
      <div class="next-step-row"><span class="ns-ico">📧</span><div><strong>Confirmation Email</strong><span>Check your inbox for booking details</span></div></div>
      <div class="next-step-row"><span class="ns-ico">✅</span><div><strong>Admin Approval</strong><span>Reviewed within 24 hours</span></div></div>
      <div class="next-step-row"><span class="ns-ico">🔔</span><div><strong>Reminder</strong><span>You will get an alert 24h before your test</span></div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="success-btns">
      <button class="btn-next" ng-click="c.viewMyAppointments()"><i class="fa fa-list"></i> View My Bookings</button>
      <button class="btn-back" ng-click="c.bookAnother()">Book Another Test</button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
